subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Explain why each item is useful on a trip.
Choose the right items for different holidays.

tf.s: You need a passport to travel to another country.
tf.why: Yes, a passport lets you enter other countries.

tf.s: You use shampoo to wash your hair.
Frank says children need a new passport every ten years.
Frank says guidebooks are heavy and you can download apps instead.
tf.why: Yes, apps are lighter than books.

tf.s: You wear flip-flops on your head.
tf.why: You wear flip-flops on your feet.

tf.s: A toothbrush and soap go in a washbag.
tf.why: Yes, a washbag holds things for washing.

tf.s: A raincoat is useful on a sunny beach.
tf.why: A raincoat is for rainy days.

tf.s: A pillow helps you sleep comfortably on a night journey.
tf.why: Yes, a pillow makes sleeping easier.

tf.s: A suitcase is something you eat on a plane.
tf.why: A suitcase is a big bag for your clothes.

tf.s: You should take medicine in case you are ill.
tf.why: Yes, medicine helps if you get sick.

boxes.q: Which item can you get as an app on your phone?
What do you wear on your feet at the beach?
boxes.why: Flip-flops are good for sand and water.

boxes.q: Complete: Take your ___ if you are ill.
boxes.why: Medicine helps when you are ill.

boxes.q: Which item do you hold over your head in the rain?
Which item goes in a washbag?
boxes.why: You clean your teeth with it.

boxes.q: Which book tells you about places to visit?
boxes.why: A guidebook gives information for tourists.

boxes.q: What do you put your clothes in for a trip?
What do you use with water to wash your hands?
Which item helps you see at night on a camping trip?
boxes.why: A torch gives light in the dark.

boxes.q: Which item do you need on a night journey to sleep well?
boxes.why: A pillow is for your head.

hunt.q: You need it to visit another country
A bag for soap and toothbrush
Take it if you are ill
You clean your teeth with it
A big bag for your clothes

mcq.q: Which items go in a washbag?
Why does Frank say not to take guidebooks?
o: They are heavy and you can use apps.
They are not allowed on planes.
mcq.why: Apps are light and easy to carry.

mcq.q: Which two items are useful for rainy days?

mcq.why: You wear flip-flops on your feet.

mcq.q: You are going on a camping trip. Which item is useful in case you get ill?
mcq.why: Medicine helps if you get sick.

mcq.q: Your family is flying to London. Which item must you take?
mcq.why: You can't enter another country without a passport.

mcq.q: Complete: You don't need a ___ on a sunny beach.
mcq.why: There is no rain, so no raincoat.

mcq.q: Why is a pillow useful on a night journey?
o: So you can wash your face.
So you can charge your phone.
So you can read about places.

mcq.q: Sara is going to a hot, sunny beach. Which list is best?
o: a raincoat, an umbrella and a pillow
mcq.why: These items are useful in the sun by the sea.

mcq.q: Which is a good travel tip of your own?
o: Take a bottle of water on long journeys.
mcq.why: Water keeps you healthy on long trips.
